accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Who can sign in to this manager, and what each account may do.

roles.admin: Everything on servers, backups, plans, .env files and files, including real restores and moves. No account management.
roles.operator: Sees everything; takes, verifies and downloads backups, runs plans, rehearses restores and moves. Changes no server and deletes nothing.

form.title: Add an account
form.body: The account sets up two-factor sign-in and chooses its own password the first time it signs in.
form.passwordHint: Give it to the person in a safe way; they replace it at their first sign-in.
form.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

disable.title: Disable the account
disable.body: {name} is signed out and cannot sign in until the account is enabled again. Nothing it did is removed.

enable.title: Enable the account
enable.body: {name} can sign in again with its password and two-factor code.

resetTwoFactor.title: Reset two-factor sign-in
resetTwoFactor.body: {name}'s authenticator and recovery codes stop working. It sets up two-factor sign-in again at its next sign-in.
resetTwoFactor.done: {name} sets up two-factor sign-in again at its next sign-in.

expirePassword.title: Ask for a new password
expirePassword.body: {name} must choose a new password at its next sign-in before it can do anything else.
expirePassword.done: {name} chooses a new password at its next sign-in.

handOver.title: Make it the master account
handOver.body: {name} becomes the master account and manages every account. Your account becomes an admin and can no longer manage accounts.
handOver.codeHint: The code your authenticator app shows now.
